node.title: Re: Batch remove URLs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
using a find/replace one liner

Please see [id://1201438], I think a module like [mod://Mojo::DOM] will be much more reliable.

As for batch processing, I'd suggest a module like [mod://File::Find::Rule] or perhaps [mod://Path::Class]'s recurse method (although the [man://find] method you showed [id://1202118|here] works too, if your script only processes one file at a time).

For that list of 300 URLs, you could perhaps [id://1179840|build a regex] out of them which you could then use to search (after having safely parsed the file with one of the modules mentioned in the link above ;-) ). If you need advanced handling of URLs, use the [mod://URI] module.
